candidates.novelty: Existing roundabout items cover sign meaning, entry priority and yielding while leaving the inner lane. None tests whether inner-lane use for a left-side destination is optional.

sources.supports: R412-9 permits moving left for an exit left of entry axis on a multi-lane roundabout; it does not mandate it. No special lane allocation stipulated.

candidates.novelty: Truck-right-turn blind-spot item asks another driver not to pass inside a truck. This asks the towing driver when the left side can be used for a tight right turn, rather than overtaking or oncoming crossing.

sources.supports: R415-3 II: left carriageway may be used if bend and vehicle dimensions prevent keeping right, only at moderate speed after ensuring no danger to others.

candidates.novelty: Existing queue question distinguishes lanes advancing at different rates; existing overtaking/merging checks do not teach the lawful filtering corridor between the two leftmost lanes.

sources.supports: Since11January2025 filtering under specified dense-traffic/road/weather conditions is between the two leftmost queues. Applies to car-driver anticipation of that location.

candidates.novelty: Existing items cover alcohol limits, points, health effects and enforcement. The uninsured-windscreen sticker item tests proof of insurance, not intoxication-related own-damage exclusions.

sources.supports: An accident caused under alcohol can lead to refusal of own bodily/material-damage guarantees, notwithstanding comprehensive cover or paid premiums; question uses may/refuses guaranteed cover, not universal contractual wording.

candidates.novelty: Bank has instantaneous limits, stopping distances and travel-time gains; no item teaches enforcement measurement averaged over a road section.

sources.supports: Official2025 radar brochure describes radar tronçon as calculating average speed over a road section.

candidates.novelty: Existing belt, headrest and child-airbag questions do not cover adult limbs obstructing front passenger airbag deployment.

sources.supports: Renault complementary restraint safety warning: feet must not be placed on dashboard or seat because deployment can cause serious injury; body parts kept away from dashboard.

candidates.novelty: Existing first-inspection item concerns fourth-anniversary schedule, not consequences of a critical failed inspection.

sources.supports: Critical R result valid only inspection day; reinspection within2months does not extend critical-result circulation validity.

candidates.novelty: Existing trailer items cover speed, vehicle length and overtaking restrictions; none tests licence entitlement based on trailer PTAC at750kg.

sources.supports: CategoryB vehicle at most3500kg may tow trailer PTAC≤750kg; code96 requires trailer>750kg and combinedPTAC>3500≤4250.

candidates.novelty: Existing administrative items concern insurance sticker, licence eyesight restriction, vehicle mass and inspections; no change-of-address deadline.

sources.supports: Owner moving withinFrance has1month to update vehicle registration address; leasing and return-from-abroad exceptions excluded.

candidates.novelty: Existing EV item rejects damaged insulation; this rejects intact but unsuitable added domestic extension/multiple sockets and requires checking the supply installation.

sources.supports: Renault instructions prohibit extension leads/adaptors/multiple sockets and require professional verification of domestic socket installation against charging specifications.
